decisions.reason: The burner component draws directly on the firm's core gas-radiant engineering, supports the installed base and the service network, and costs little to maintain.
This flagship electric panel line carries the firm's infrared know-how into electrification, and after Product D was dropped it is the main electric focus that in-house R&D can keep improving.
The halogen heater stays close to established infrared knowledge, but the earlier pruning of overlapping electric lines raises its risk somewhat, though not enough to justify dropping it now.

The hydrogen-ready dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with documented real-world operation, built on core gas-radiant expertise and the firm's low-carbon direction, so it will keep receiving R&D investment.
